method: Code inspection of service/app/db/{clickhouse,postgres,qdrant,milvus}.py + service/app/search/strategies.py + service/app/config.py + service/app/db/registry.py, cross-checked against live health() calls against the already-running video-search-faz7-{pg,ch,qdrant} containers (ports 5442/8143/6343) using current-HEAD code via PYTHONPATH=service.

clickhouse.role: production default vector backend (current default and, per plan, to remain default unless evidence says otherwise)
clickhouse.live_health_check: pass (health()==True against live container this session)
known_defects_at_baseline: candidate_count in search_vectors() diagnostics counts the filtered corpus, not the candidate_ids set, when candidate_ids is provided (clickhouse.py count_sql omits candidate_clause) -- see Phase -1.1
client() opens a brand-new clickhouse_connect connection on every call, no reuse -- see Phase -1.4
EXPLAIN indexes=1 and an unconditional count() query run on every search_vectors() call regardless of need -- see Phase -1.3

qdrant.benchmark_supported: partial (bench/ package has no qdrant-specific harness yet; product-plane adapter is otherwise at parity with clickhouse for run-versioning operations)
qdrant.role: enableable alternative vector backend (matches plan's expected role)
qdrant.live_health_check: pass (health()==True against live container this session)
known_defects_at_baseline: search_vectors() candidate_count diagnostic is computed via a separate target.count() call that explicitly passes candidate_ids=None to _filter(), so it counts the filtered collection, not the candidate set -- same class of bug as clickhouse.py, see Phase -1.1

pgvector.role: enableable alternative vector backend (matches plan's expected role)
pgvector.live_health_check: pass (health()==True against live container this session)
known_defects_at_baseline: search_vectors() computes candidate_count via a count(*) query executed BEFORE the candidate_clause is appended to params/sql (postgres.py:473-481) -- same class of bug, see Phase -1.1

milvus.config_enableable_detail: VECTOR_BACKENDS in config.py is ('clickhouse','qdrant','pgvector'); milvus is absent, so ENABLED_VECTOR_BACKENDS=milvus fails Settings.validate() at process startup. registry.py's BACKEND_REGISTRY (used by /health, /stats, initialize_enabled_backends) also omits milvus entirely.
milvus.search_supported: partial and latently broken -- milvus.search_vectors(dataset_id, dimension, query_vector, top_k, strategy, candidate_ids) has no run_id/metadata_filters/telemetry_filters parameters at all, while service/app/search/engine.py's BACKENDS dispatch calls every backend with those as keyword arguments whenever an active run exists or filter_execution_mode=pushdown is active. A direct call would raise TypeError. In practice this is NOT reachable through the public HTTP contract today: main.py's POST /search handler rejects request.backend not in settings.enabled_vector_backends before engine.search() is ever called, and milvus can never be in enabled_vector_backends (see config_enableable_detail). Only reachable via direct internal Python calls (e.g. a bench/ script calling engine.BACKENDS['milvus'] or engine.search() directly), not via the API.
milvus.role: incomplete/experimental search-only adapter, exactly matching the plan's own expected characterization -- worse than 'incomplete', it is unreachable via the current enabled-backend governance path and would crash if called with the kwargs the engine's dispatch contract requires for the run-scoped/pushdown paths.
milvus.compose_profile: a real, opt-in Milvus stack (milvus 2.4.15 + etcd + minio) is defined in docker-compose.faz7.yml behind `profiles: ["milvus"]`, but is absent from every other docker-compose*.yml. This compose profile exists but was not brought up or exercised this session (out of scope: milvus is not production_supported and the plan explicitly says not to promote it to production status just because a file exists).
milvus.reason: no milvus service was brought up this session; config_enableable=false means it cannot be exercised through the normal settings-driven lifecycle even if it were up.
milvus.pymilvus_installed_version_caveat: This session installed pymilvus 3.0.1 (latest) to unblock exploration; service/requirements.txt pins pymilvus==2.4.9 (a different major version). service/app/db/milvus.py's MilvusClient usage was not verified against either version's actual live behavior this session.

numpy_exact.config_enableable_detail: Same as milvus -- absent from VECTOR_BACKENDS/BACKEND_REGISTRY, unreachable via ENABLED_VECTOR_BACKENDS or the public /search contract.
numpy_exact.schema_initializable: not_applicable (in-memory reference implementation, no persistent schema)
numpy_exact.search_supported: only via direct internal call, same reachability caveat as milvus
numpy_exact.role: benchmark correctness reference only, exactly matching the plan's expected characterization -- must never be presented as a production backend or as production-equivalent latency.

cross_cutting_findings.two_separate_backend_maps_exist: service/app/db/registry.py::BACKEND_REGISTRY (clickhouse/qdrant/pgvector only, drives /health, /stats, schema init lifecycle) is a different, smaller mapping than service/app/search/engine.py::BACKENDS (adds milvus and numpy_exact, drives actual per-request search dispatch). This is why milvus/numpy_exact can exist in code without being enableable -- they are wired into the dispatch table but never into the governance table.
cross_cutting_findings.research_plane_isolation_confirmed: Verified zero import edges from service/app/** into the repo-root search/, bench/, eval/, or models/ packages (grep swept and manually verified every hit as a false positive -- either service/app's own app.search/app.bench sub-packages, unrelated .search()/re.search() method calls, or the vendored external Qwen3-VL-Embedding repo path). The plan's Section 0 claim that research and product planes are already separated is already_implemented and should be preserved as-is, not re-engineered.
